findings.title: High missingness in exit interview data
findings.statement: The exit_interview_score column had 87.27 percent missing values, necessitating its removal from the dataset.
findings.recommendation: Since this feature is removed, consider if other proxy variables for employee sentiment are available.

findings.title: Age distribution skew and outliers
findings.statement: The age column has a skew of 3.58 with 2 IQR outliers present in the dataset.
findings.recommendation: Investigate the source of these extreme values and consider clipping or removing these specific records if they are erroneous.

findings.title: Missing manager notes and prompt injections
findings.statement: The manager_notes column had 37.27 percent missing values and contained prompt injection attempts in 2 cells.
findings.recommendation: Monitor text fields for prompt injection attempts and utilize the added missing indicators for model training.

findings.title: Data quality score improvement
findings.statement: The data quality score improved from 88.5 out of 100 to 100.0 out of 100 after applying cleaning procedures.
findings.recommendation: Use the cleaned dataset for modeling since structural quality issues have been resolved.

findings.title: Target class distribution imbalance
findings.statement: The target variable left_company contains 288 negative instances and 42 positive instances.
findings.recommendation: Apply class balancing techniques such as SMOTE or class weighting during model training due to the imbalance.

findings.title: Physically impossible age values in dataset
findings.statement: The age column contains invalid values such as a minimum of -3.0 and a maximum of 212.0 that require cleaning beyond simple outlier flagging.
findings.recommendation: Filter out or properly impute these physiologically impossible values before using the age feature in any models.

narrative.headline: Dataset cleaned and ready for attrition modeling with 100.0 out of 100 quality score
narrative.executive_summary: The hr_attrition.csv dataset was successfully cleaned, raising its data quality score from 88.5 out of 100 to 100.0 out of 100. The target variable left_company is heavily imbalanced with 288 negative instances and 42 positive instances. Critical issues such as extreme age outliers, 87.27 percent missingness in exit interview scores, and prompt injections in 37.27 percent missing manager notes were resolved. All necessary standardizations, type castings, and missing value treatments have been applied.
next_steps: Address the class imbalance between the 288 negative instances and 42 positive instances in left_company using appropriate sampling techniques
Account for the age column skew of 3.58 and the 2 IQR outliers during model feature engineering
Utilize the added missing indicator for manager_notes to retain signal from the 37.27 percent missing values
Train and evaluate baseline attrition prediction models using the fully typed and cleaned features

cleaning.description: Turn missing-value tokens ('N/A', '-', '?', 'null', '') into real missing values.
cleaning.changes: Changed 288 values in 'exit_interview_score', all now missing (e.g. '' → (missing)); changed 123 values in 'manager_notes', all now missing (e.g. '' → (missing)).
cleaning.rationale: Standardize missing-value tokens into real nulls across all columns.

cleaning.description: Convert text numbers to numbers (unparseable -> missing).

cleaning.description: Replace text written to instruct an AI (prompt injection) with a marker, so the cleaned data is safe to give to language models.
